candidates.excerpt: A 65-year-old man was killed and two others injured when their two-wheeler overturned at Salugupalli village in Bejjur mandal on Thursday. The three were returning to Rechini after an ophthalmology consultation in Easgaon when the rider lost control at a curve.

candidates.title: Jantar Mantar protests demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation: Delhi orders liquor shops shut on October 9-10
candidates.excerpt: The Delhi government has ordered the closure of retail liquor shops across the national capital citing the “prevailing situation” and inputs from the Delhi Police as a precautionary measure to maintain public order.

candidates.title: 'BJP's poll campaign has begun': Mann on CBI raids on OSD, 5 others
candidates.excerpt: Punjab's Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has leveled allegations against the BJP, claiming the use of Central investigative agencies for political leverage. He interpreted the recent CBI raids on his office as a signal of an impending election campaign. Mann reiterated his dedication to the interests of Punjab's citizens, dismissing corruption claims and drawing parallels with similar tactics in other states with non-BJP leadership.

candidates.title: India aims to be self-reliant in shipping and shipbuilding by 2047: Sonowal
candidates.excerpt: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal said the government is building an ecosystem to help domestic shipyards win global orders as India targets a spot among the world's top five shipbuilding nations.

candidates.title: Man Posing As IAF Officer Arrested Near Secunderabad Parade Ground
candidates.excerpt: During questioning, police officials found that Nitish Kumar had been luring young women by claiming to be an Air Force officer.

candidates.title: India condemns Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia airports, civilian deaths as ‘completely unacceptable’
candidates.excerpt: India's remarks came after three people reportedly died and 36 others were injured following the strikes on Abha International Airport and King Khalid International Airport that took place separately on October 6 and 7.

candidates.title: Setback for MLC Anantha Babu In Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: YSRCP MLC Anantha Babu and his wife Lakshmi Durga, the main accused in the murder of Dalit driver V. Subrahmanyam in Kakinada, suffered a setback in the Supreme Court.

candidates.title: Telangana Ministers, TPCC Chief Detained during March to Lok Bhavan
candidates.excerpt: Holding party flags, the leaders took out a rally from the statue of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and tried to proceed towards Lok Bhavan

candidates.title: Tejashwi Yadav leads Patna protest against SIR, demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation
candidates.excerpt: RJD leader and Leader of Opposition in the Bihar Assembly, Tejashwi Yadav, joined the Mahagathbandhan’s protest in Patna on Thursday against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and the functioning of the Election Commission.
